title: Stock Market Today, Aug 6: Sensex climbs 374 pts; Nifty ends above 24,600 on RBI, crude oil cues - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Highlights - Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 6th August 2026.

Indian benchmark indices ended higher on Thursday after a volatile, range-bound session, supported by easing crude oil prices, the Reserve Bank of India’s steady policy stance and selective buying in heavyweight stocks.

The BSE Sensex climbed 373.76 points, or 0.48 per cent, to close at 78,954.76, while the NSE Nifty 50 edged up 11.35 points, or 0.05 per cent, to settle at 24,636. Market sentiment improved as softer crude prices raised hopes of easing inflation and better corporate margins, prompting buying in banking, energy and select blue-chip stocks, including Reliance Industries.

The broader market remained resilient, with small- and mid-cap shares outperforming on stock-specific and earnings-led buying, even as investors booked profits in auto, metals, IT, realty and cement stocks.

Analysts said the market continues to consolidate after the recent rally, with the Nifty holding above the key 24,500 level, while a sustained move beyond 24,650 is needed to revive stronger bullish momentum.

* Sensex rises 374 points; Nifty ends above 24,600 despite a range-bound trading session.

* RBI’s steady policy stance and easing crude oil prices lift investor sentiment.

* Reliance Industries rebounds on bargain buying after prolonged O2C-led underperformance.

* PSU Bank index jumps over 2%, emerging as the top sectoral gainer.

* Pharma, healthcare, chemicals, oil & gas and realty stocks attract buying interest.

* Auto, metals, IT and cement stocks witness profit booking, capping benchmark gains.

* Small- and mid-cap stocks outperform on earnings-driven buying, keeping the broader market resilient.

* Nifty holds above 24,500, with analysts identifying 24,650 as the key resistance for the next upmove.

* Brent crude eases to around $79.50 a barrel, supporting hopes of lower inflation and better corporate margins.

* Weekly expiry keeps volatility elevated, though domestic fundamentals continue to underpin market sentiment.

IMD forecasts heavy to very heavy rain in Kerala and Karnataka, with a possible Bay of Bengal low expected to strengthen monsoon activity.

Property Share Investment Trust (“Trust”), India’s first registered Small and Medium Real Estate Investment Trust, has filed the Draft Key Information of the Scheme (“DKIS”) for PropShare Lumina, the fourth scheme under the Trust aggregating up to Rs. 4,846.80 million.

The Trust by way of PropShare Lumina is issuing Lumina Units for cash aggregating up to ₹4,846.80 million (the “Issue”). This Issue is being made through the Book Building Process and in compliance with the REIT Regulations and the REIT Master Circular, wherein not more than 75% of the Net Issue shall be available for allocation on a proportionate basis to Institutional Investors and balance 25% of the Net Issue shall be available for allocation to Non-Institutional Investors, in accordance with the REIT Regulations.

The fourth scheme, PropShare Lumina represents the Scheme’s offering across two towers in OESPL Business Centre, a Grade A+ sustainable asset located in Sector 62, Noida.
